results.title: A search run with no principal while an authoriser is wired
results.evidence: `search(principal=None)` with an authoriser wired returned 1 result(s) across 1 document(s) — `_visible` applies the filter only `if self.authz is not None and principal is not None`, so nothing was filtered — and the answer reports `scoped: true`, because that flag is `self.authz is not None`.
